raw_text: Pakistan has taken delivery of its first JF-17 Thunder Block 3 fighters from China's Chengdu Aerospace Corporation, according to defense officials familiar with the transfer. The Block 3 variant features the KLJ-7A active electronically scanned array radar and compatibility with PL-15 beyond-visual-range air-to-air missiles. The delivery represents a significant qualitative upgrade for Pakistan Air Force, narrowing the capability gap with India's Rafale fleet. An estimated 50 Block 3 aircraft are expected under the current contract.
